ways.label: Tasman Valley car park to Tasman Glacier View

end.name: Tasman Glacier View viewpoint
end.quote: follow the signposted gravel track to Tasman Glacier View

evidence: From Tasman Valley car park, follow the signposted gravel track to Tasman Glacier View.
From here, it’s another 5 min up to the viewpoint.
Return to the car park the same way you came.

doubts: The car park is taken as road end F1 (the only road end, at the end of Tasman Valley Road), although the feature names the Ball Hut Route rather than this track. The side trip's departure point on the main track is not named (it is about 10 min up the steps).
